## What does this change?

<!-- e.g. "Adds Austria (ÖGK) with 3 letters" / "French translation" / "Fixes § 13 citation" -->

## Type
- [ ] New country / legal system
- [ ] New language (UI translation)
- [ ] Correction of legal or medical content
- [ ] App / code change

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (the bot runs it too)
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Every legal claim links to an **official** text (law database, court website)
- [ ] Every study has a DOI, and I have read it
- [ ] No tracking, no network calls, no external scripts or fonts
- [ ] I updated `lastReviewed` in the country file (if legal content changed)

## Who reviewed the legal content?
<!-- Your background (lawyer, patient organisation, affected person, …). A pseudonym is fine.
     Country files need at least one review by someone familiar with that legal system before merge. -->
